dod_intent_evidence: Channel notes report a $49.7M USAF/AFRL contract to mature MSRS's alternative-navigation technology for GPS-denied environments, and the site states its systems are 'currently deployed in the field in some of the most GPS denied regions on the planet.'
score_evidence: Only open role is 'Senior System Software Engineer' with no field, ISSO, or compliance roles visible → hiring_profile_skew
'$49.7M contract to mature its alternative-navigation technology for GPS-denied environments' against an 8-person team → stage_pressure

blind_spots.blind_spot: Their own mapping data flow depends on 'downloadable and online software' and a cloud MSRS database
blind_spots.operator_reality: A navigation system built to survive GPS jamming in denied environments still leans on connectivity for its mapping database — same failure mode as the 30fps crowd-detection case: the one dependency they didn't harden is the one that breaks first in a DDIL environment
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: product messaging is built around GPS-denial resilience specifically, so comms-denial for the data layer may be an unexamined blind spot
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Users get access to the MSRS® database of mapping and navigation information, which is integrated into both MSRS's® downloadable and online software

blind_spots.blind_spot: No ATO/RMF/CMMC/ITAR language anywhere despite a $49.7M AFRL contract and ATAK integration
blind_spots.operator_reality: A navigation system meant to plug into ATAK and scale under a large AFRL award will need an ATO to get onto government networks at fielding scale; silence on this at $49.7M-contract stage is a live risk to the transition timeline
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: 8-person team with a single open software engineering role suggests no dedicated compliance/ISSO function yet
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Whether using our user interface or operating on ATAK, you can rest assured that you're getting good intel so you can stay focused on the mission

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Easily installed on wheeled and tracked vehicles' with no discussion of who trains the installer or sustains the unit in the field
blind_spots.operator_reality: SOF-veteran pedigree buys credibility but is not a training pipeline; a sergeant fielding this at scale needs documented install/repair procedures and spares logistics, not just founder credibility
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: marketing emphasizes founder authenticity ('veteran founded, veteran operated, veteran manufactured') over a formal training/sustainment program
blind_spots.evidence_quote: SOF veteran founded, veteran operated, veteran manufactured, made in the USA

opener_hook: MSRS's $49.7M AFRL contract is set to mature GPS-denied navigation tech already described as fielded in some of the most jammed regions on the planet — worth asking how the mapping database performs without connectivity.
what_they_do: SOF-veteran-founded sensor-fusion navigation system (Multi Source Reckoning System) that keeps vehicles on track when GPS is jammed or spoofed, integrating with ATAK for GPS-denied operations.
